output.caveat: Nonspinning-limit JF17 fit (chi1=chi2=0 assumed absent input spins); aligned-spin 2D/3D correction terms not implemented. PI-gap edges and GW231123-class remnant masses carry model/waveform-systematics uncertainty (see arXiv:2509.09161 for ML-based validation of these fits against NR).
output.pi_gap_note: PI mass-gap edges (~60-130 Msun) are model-dependent (nuclear reaction rates, rotation, metallicity -- e.g. Farmer et al. 2019, Woosley 2019), not sharp thresholds.
output.reference: Jimenez-Forteza et al. 2017, PRD 95, 064024 (arXiv:1611.00332), nonspinning-limit fits (Eqs. 7 and 21); PI-gap edges model-dependent (e.g. Farmer et al. 2019); GW231123 waveform-systematics ML validation: Chatterjee et al. 2025 (arXiv:2509.09161)
output.register: peer-reviewed fit (JF17), applied here in its nonspinning limit; PI-gap edges and waveform-systematics for GW231123-class remnants are model-dependent -- see caveat
